ridge.definition: All1000 symmetric single-effect features; fitted standardization and intercept; regularized dual linear solve; no target double outcomes at prediction.

direct_ridge.definition: All1000 symmetric single-effect features; fitted standardization and intercept; regularized dual linear solve; no target double outcomes at prediction.

qualification.matching_mean_equation: (A+B)/2 for both-seen-single interventions; no unseen-single fallback admitted.
qualification.selection: Select both direct-effect and additive-residual ridge families by median pair calibration RMSE; pooled RMSE then larger alpha and residual prior tie breaks; refit all development.
